summary: Delmarva Power & Light filed an 8-K reporting entry into a March 19, 2026 Bond Purchase Agreement and the September 16, 2026 closing of $150 million of First Mortgage Bonds: $75 million 5.00% Series due September 16, 2036, and $75 million 5.74% Series due March 19, 2056. Sold under Section 4(a)(2) exemption, secured by the 1943 Mortgage and Deed of Trust as supplemented March 1, 2026. Proceeds repay existing indebtedness and fund general corporate purposes. No governance, M&A, or special-situation mechanics; a routine private debt financing.
